note: Strain / over-exertion (Dave 2026-10-20). strain climbs with no hard limit while effort (movement speed, tool work and heavy loads, 0 to 1+) is above rest_effort, and falls when below it. Walking is sustainable; running is not. State 0 normal; at over_on the player is OVER-EXERTED (speed cap, no sprint) until strain falls under over_off; past faint_at the player FAINTS (movement locked) for faint_s seconds, vision fades over the first vision_frac of that time and the heartbeat over the rest; then WAKING for wake_s while the heart still races, strain restarts at wake_strain and falls at wake_fall_mult of the normal pace until it is under over_off. Thresholds scale with body weight (heavier tires sooner) and a fitness factor (placeholder 1.0 until fitness exists). No death.
